hints.title: Rigid Body Grid State Formulation
hints.text: The snake of length two is uniquely defined by its tail coordinate and its orientation (horizontal or vertical).

hints.title: Four Directed Move Transitions
hints.text: Move right, move down, rotate clockwise, or rotate counter-clockwise. Verify all occupied cells are empty.

hints.title: BFS Distance Exploration Blueprint
hints.text: Initialize queue with (0, 0, 0) for tail (0,0) horizontal. Advance step by step until reaching tail (n-1, n-2, 0).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Total possible states is 2 * N * N, visited once by breadth-first search.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unbounded depth-first search revisits cyclic rotation loops without tracking shortest path distance.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Visited set keyed by tail coordinate and orientation prevents infinite state loops.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Breadth-first search on discrete state (r, c, orientation) with rigorous 2x2 clearance checks.

solutions.approach: Augmented State BFS on 2-Cell Body Grid
